tagline: Enormous swings, then it stands perfectly still until it is just another tree

featuredCards.title: The Forest Walks
featuredCards.caption: Five spaces, straight through whoever is standing there. It crosses the board faster than anything its size should.

featuredCards.title: Old Growth
featuredCards.caption: A clean 6 with no conditions. The oak does not need a combo to hurt you.

featuredCards.title: Breaking Boughs
featuredCards.caption: Wins and splashes everyone next to it. Grouping up against a tree this size is a mistake.

featuredCards.title: Rooted Elsewhere
featuredCards.caption: Attacks, then steps away into an empty space — so it ends the turn alone and draws for it.
